_comment: The id of a bank charge, the same whichever way it arrived. Two sources file the bank's USD charges: the Gmail ingestion (tools/gmail-bank-ingest, JavaScript) and the BBVA app's notification through the Shortcuts action "Cargo del banco" (iOS, Swift). One purchase can arrive by both, so the id is built from what both know — the household-timezone date, the USD cents and the card's last four digits — and the second to arrive finds the document already there: deduplication without a query. The cost, accepted by Cristian on 2026-10-26: two identical purchases on one day with the same card become one charge. A charge with no card digits says `none`. The Firestore rules check a client-created charge's id against this same shape.
